# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is a remarkably pretty girl with dark-lashed violet eyes, very white teeth, and a crooked smile. She has a nose that follows the Gordon pattern, though she worries about its future development. She grows noticeably thin after having her children.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Philippa is lively, outgoing, and candid, easily making friends wherever she goes. Though she appears frivolous and indecisive on the surface, she is a loyal, un-snobbish friend with a golden heart. She is given to humorous dramatic flair and freely admits her own flaws.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c4 P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c10 P55](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0055), [v3 c19 P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 c35 P12](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0012)_

## Goals

- To be chummy and close friends with Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant  <sub>[v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)</sub>

## History

Philippa meets Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant during her first days at Redmond College in Kingsport, immediately taking a liking to them and bringing them into her social circle. During her college years, she struggles to choose between two beaux from home, Alec and Alonzo, while enjoying the attention of various suitors at college. She moves into Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue with Anne, Priscilla, and Stella, enjoying a happy household life there. During a summer break, she falls in love with the Reverend Jo Blake, standing firm against her mother's initial disapproval until her parents accept him. She marries Jo shortly after graduating from Redmond and later attends Anne's wedding at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P30](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0030), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c7 P51](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0051), [v3 c10 P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of a rich and prominent family in Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- Raised at Mount Holly, her family's homestead in Bolingbroke  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>
- Her paternal grandfather was a minister  <sub>[v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>
